prerequisites: Knowledge acquired in the access degrees listed in the Master's Program Memory
Having completed the subjects developed in the first semester of the Master

learning_outcomes.text: Know the contents developed in this module.
Acquisition of laboratory work skills and systematic approach, typical of the subjects taught.
Manage the scientific equipment used in these subjects to design specific tests or experiments and to interpret the results obtained from them.
Write a scientific paper in a summarized way and present it orally with clarity.

syllabus_topics: Advanced topics related to structural integrity
Specialized topics related to structural integrity
Topics at the frontier of knowledge related to structural integrity
New topics of recent professional application related to structural integrity
Practical work complementing Numerical Simulation, e.g., specific modeling (crack growth, material models)
Practical complements to any other Master's course
Introduction to doctoral studies and presentation of current research projects
teaching_methods: Provision of necessary materials for comprehension
Problem solving under direct professor tutoring
assessment_rules: Given the specificity of this Advanced Seminar, it is not possible to indicate a priori how the evaluation will be carried out. Different possibilities are considered, such as a brief written exam with short questions at the end of the expository classes, resolution of exercises or specific works related to the topic presented, and evaluation of student participation in class. At a minimum, a test will be conducted at the end of the seminar.
bibliography: Text or notes prepared by the professor(s) teaching the contents of the different topics.
A set of available exercises or problems with their solutions.
